abi.model_status: raw-byte reconstruction across a Ghidra function-boundary split

mechanics: Read the input byte from ESP+0x04 and initialize the result byte to zero.
Set result bit 0x1 when input bit 0x1 is set.
Set result bit 0x2 when input bit 0x2 is set.
Set result bit 0x4 when input bit 0x4 is set.
Pass receiver+0x140 as the first helper argument, load receiver+0x170 into ECX, pass the normalized byte as the second helper argument, and call 0x011f3d40.
Return the helper result. The raw byte stream shows no null guard for receiver+0x170; forwarding null or sentinel camera pointers remains observable behavior.

receiver_fields.meaning: four-word opaque background/state block passed to helper
opaque camera/receiver object passed as helper ECX

target_layout.evidence: Ghidra App::cViewer layout corroborates receiver+0x140 and receiver+0x170; raw disassembled bytes at 0x007c3c50-0x007c3c83 prove the continuation past Ghidra's split boundary.

call_graph.boundary_note: Ghidra's function record ends at 0x007c3c6f and labels the continuation as App::cViewer::Dispose; the direct raw call and 0x011f3d40 are not ignored because of that split.

evidence.observation: Ghidra reports FUN_007c3c50 at 0x007c3c50 with body range 0x007c3c50-0x007c3c6f.
The decompiler proves normalization of bits 0x1, 0x2, and 0x4 and the call shape to 0x011f3d40.
Raw disassembly runs through 0x007c3c83, loads [ECX+0x170] into ECX, passes [receiver+0x140] and the normalized byte to 0x011f3d40, then uses RET 0x4.
The imported cViewer layout reports size 372 and the fields used by the raw continuation.

confidence.overall: high for flag mask, helper argument order, raw continuation, and return forwarding
medium: concrete helper type and renderer effect
low: semantic meaning of each retained bit beyond the raw flag positions

unresolved_questions: The concrete type and effect of helper 0x011f3d40 are not established by the target bytes.
The retained bit values are not promoted to named semantic flags without downstream evidence.
blockers: No runtime render-state trace is available.
The Ghidra function-boundary split at 0x007c3c70 must be corrected or bypassed before any automatic integration.
